integrity: Theorems are supported by the displayed analytical proof; finite computations are only consistency diagnostics. No independent audit or external certification has occurred.
scientific_limitations: One-dimensional drift-free Brownian diffusion with an independent Poisson reset clock and a deterministic multiplier. Assertions cover stationary laws only and a multiplier tending to zero. Exact invariant-density formulas in prior literature are acknowledged; only the derived matched singular asymptotic and sharp total-variation coefficient are assessed.
title: A singular reset-point layer and sharp total variation for nearly complete Brownian resetting
